seed_note.text: China's heavy rare earth controls have split the market into licensed and non-licensed buyers. Controls suspended under a truce are due to return on November 10, 2026 unless extended, and in June 2026 China put MP Materials and USA Rare Earth on its export control list. China holds about 91% of global refining capacity (IEA, via S&P).
